body: It's too bad your website stated (until quite recently) that Angular Instant Search was compatible with the latest versions of Angular.  I wouldn't have upgraded our Angular version at that time.  Unfortunately your website was misleading, or just an outright lie, and I did the upgrade, then had to replace all of our Algolia widgets with our own components and instantsearch.js API calls.   Cost me about 100 hours that I can't get back.
